author: JacobHHilton
text: A rare case of a surprising empirical result about LLMs with a crisp theoretical explanation. Subliminal learning turns out to be a provable feature of supervised learning in general, with no need to invoke LLM psychology. (Explained in Section 6.)

quoted.text:
New paper & surprising result.
LLMs transmit traits to other models via hidden signals in data.
Datasets consisting only of 3-digit numbers can transmit a love for owls, or evil tendencies. 🧵 https://t.co/ewIxfzXOe3

author: JacobHHilton
text: Throughout multiple announcements and court filings, OpenAI has failed to address the issue of control, which currently belongs to the non-profit. The only reasonable interpretation is that they will take this asset from the non-profit if they can get away with it.

author: JacobHHilton
text: It is sad to see @OpenAI's mission being reinterpreted to mean "proliferate OpenAI's products among non-profits". This is not the mission articulated in the OpenAI Charter, which it championed for years internally. It is the least onerous alternative that still says "non-profit".

quoted.text:
He’s been spreading false information about us. We’re actually getting ready to build the best-equipped nonprofit the world has ever seen – we’re not converting it away.

More info here: https://t.co/oCHU0MUAoL
